# BD × AI Lab — the MDL×DCC research program

> Human-led research and engineering by Bojan Dobrečevič (Ljubljana, Slovenia), developed through the AIM³ human–AI collaboration framework. The core idea is one compression-based optimization kernel — MDL×DCC: a Minimum Description Length quality sensor coupled with Directed/Dynamic Complexity Control (DCC) governance. The same kernel is explored across chess, travelling-salesman optimization, lossless audio, genome compression, trading, Sudoku, crosswords, prime gaps, network routing, and a consciousness research line (CCH / Absolute Consciousness). Claims are treated as testable where possible: build first, then pressure-test with baselines and reproducible artifacts.

## Start here
- [Full site index — every HTML page](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/i.html): Complete color-coded map generated from i.txt; currently lists 268 HTML pages.
- [BD × AI Lab — Portfolio](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/bd/): Public portfolio — working prototypes, results, and the AIM³ method.
- [AIM³ — collaboration method](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/bd/BD_AIM3.html): Human-led human–AI collaboration with role-based models, persistent state, decision trails, and tests over opinion.
- [AIM³ RHP](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/bd/BD_AIM3_RHP.html): Resonance Hybrid Protocol for multi-agent brainstorming.
- [AIM³ RHPr](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/bd/BD_AIM3_RHPr.html): Prompting / retrieval protocol for avoiding answer-lock.
- [8Z Reasoning](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/bd/BD_8Z_Reasoning.html): Cross-domain-transfer reasoning method.

## Core method and arenas
- [Core Research Papers hub](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/crp/): Broad research hub across MDL×DCC, AI8, SORA, DGTE, RouteSignal, RH/PiX, and arenas.
- [MDL×DCC](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/crp/MDLxDCC.html): Cross-domain kernel — MDL as structure pressure, DCC as recursive steering.
- [MDL×DCC Demon](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/crp/MDLxDCC-Demon.html): Feedback-information-engine testing branch.
- [MDL×DCC Arenas](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/crp/MDLxDCC-Arenas.html): Empirical arenas pressure-testing the kernel against standard baselines.
- [AI8 Reasoning](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/crp/AI8_Reasoning.html) and [AI8 Architecture](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/crp/AI8_Architecture.html): Method and architecture behind the collaboration.
- [RouteSignal Scout](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/bd/RouteSignal_Scout.html): MDL×DCC / prompt-method study for internet routing-style signal scouting.

## Applied domains
- [8Z-RP — TSP solver](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/bd/BD_8ZRP.html): Route-planning / travelling-salesman solver branch.
- [8Z compression](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/8Z/8Z_compression.html): Compression and data-system work.
- [8Z-AC Audio Codec](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/AC/8Z-AC_main.html): Lossless audio-codec branch.
- [8Z DNA / FASTA](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/LO/8Z_DNA_FASTA.html): Genomics / FASTA compression branch.
- [Sudoku](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/S/8zSudoku.html), [Crosswords](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/CW/8z_CW.html), and [Flip4M](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/F4M/F4M.html): Solver/game arenas.
- [BD Trading 2026](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/bd/BD_trading_2026.html) and [Hedge Separation PiX Strategy Explainer](https://www.mdlxdcc.org/bd/BD_Hedge_Separation_PiX_Strategy_Explainer.html): Current trading research pages not yet strongly linked from the /bd/ hub.
